repos.readmeExcerpt: # agent-panel Embed a small agent panel in any app and hand a feature's task to an [Agent Client Protocol](https://agentclientprotocol.com) agent. ACP, [`@tutti-os/agent-acp-kit`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@tutti-os/agent-acp-kit), and [acp-components](https://github.com/Endlessworld/acp-components) already cover agent backends and a full ACP workbench. [open-slide](https://github.com/open-slide/open-slide) showed an in-app panel wired to one product. agent-panel is the layer in between: a capability registry, writable-root and tool policy, and a thin panel.
